sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide is written in our own words for this guide; each cites the source its facts come from. Steps with no confirmed method at launch say so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do. Treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the real final step, since it gates the platinum. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay, so a missed step can cost a second playthrough.

trophies.guide: Play the story mission Gone Fishing to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed — just keep playing Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it lands a beat late.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. It covers story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries; known targets include 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles and all 8 bank vaults. This is the long grind behind the platinum, estimated at around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. The one step that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload and try again.
